# cb:b589

> Each referenced proto-belief document carries its route-tagged excerpts as an append-only, per-thread, date-stamped log of whole tagged paragraphs, materialized into the document and never regenerated; a document accepts appends while its matter is unresolved and freezes acceptance when the matter resolves.
